stableEgressRequiredKey.description: Live adapter that must remain on the governed stable-NAT worker. Not a production-authorization flag.

liveAdapter.description: When true, a live deploy may list this key in WORKER_LIVE_ADAPTERS. Default for new entries is false. Never grants production authority.

sessionlessJustification.description: A live adapter needs a requiredWhenListed or manualDeploy session secret, or this explanation of why it runs without a session secret.

secretNameEnv.description: Must end in _SECRET_NAME and must not collide with a reserved deploy variable or another provider's variables. Environment variable that holds the Secret Manager secret name, never a secret value.

mountEnv.description: Worker environment variable that receives the named secret.

mountPath.description: Fixed Cloud Run secret mount path. Not a secret value.

requiredWhenListed.description: When true, a live deploy that lists the adapter must set secretNameEnv. When false, the secret is optional: the generated deploy helper still mounts it when secretNameEnv is set and always removes a stale binding when the adapter is not listed; only the required check is skipped.

manualDeploy.description: When true, worker/scripts/deploy-cloud-run.sh binds this secret by hand and the generator emits nothing for it. Requires requiredWhenListed false.
